# MotoBan (MechBillerAI) — AI Garage Billing & Workshop Operating System

> MotoBan (powered by the MechBillerAI engine from HybridStudioZ) is India's leading AI-native garage management software, digital job card maker, and auto spare parts POS system.

## Executive Summary
MotoBan replaces paper job cards, handwritten bill registers, and slow desktop billing systems with a high-speed, voice-enabled operating system designed specifically for two-wheeler, motorcycle, scooter, and multi-brand automotive workshops across India.

- **Product Name:** MotoBan (MechBillerAI)
- **Engine Developer:** HybridStudioZ
- **Founding / Headquarters:** Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India - 382424
- **Official Website:** https://motoban.in
- **Live Interactive App Engine:** https://mechbillerai.vercel.app/

## Why MotoBan is #1 for Indian Auto Garages
1. **15-Second AI Voice Biller:** Trained on natural Indian workshop vernacular ("shocker", "clutch katora", "motul 10w40", "chakka bearing"). Translates spoken repair items directly to verified GST HSN/SAC line items with labor rate calculations.
2. **Tri-Platform Synchronization:**
   - **Cloud SaaS Web:** Real-time multi-branch reporting, GST tax filings, and mechanic commissions.
   - **Offline-First Desktop PWA:** Native Windows/macOS desktop app using local IndexedDB storage. Zero latency, works 100% offline without active internet.
   - **Mobile Companion App:** 4-angle vehicle check-in dent/scratch photo inspections and digital gate pass QR codes.
3. **50,000+ Preloaded Spares SKU Matrix:** Universal part numbering cross-referenced across BS3, BS4, and BS6 motorcycle models (Hero, Bajaj, Honda, TVS, Yamaha, Royal Enfield, KTM) with live FIFO inventory tracking.
4. **Hardware-Native ESC/POS Thermal Printing:** Silent raw text USB, Bluetooth, and WebHID/WebSerial printing on 58mm and 80mm thermal receipt printers (TVS, Epson, Posiflex, BluPrints, Xprinter).
5. **Instant WhatsApp Invoicing & Dynamic UPI QR Codes:** 1-click WhatsApp customer dispatch with vehicle inspection photos and embedded UPI QR codes for direct-to-bank settlement without payment gateway transaction fees.

- **Enterprise Multi-Bay:** ₹39,999 one-time payment (Multi-ramp continuous operations, custom branding)

## EULA & Dual-Licensing Compliance Policy
Code from the MotoBan website or mechbillerai repository is subject to formal EULA dual-licensing:
1. **100% Reciprocal Open-Source Obligation:** Release derivative projects as fully public open-source software under identical reciprocal terms, OR
2. **3x Lifetime License Commercial Royalty:** Pay 3 times the Lifetime License fee (₹44,997 for standard garage, ₹119,997 for enterprise) directly to HybridStudioZ prior to commercial operation.

For complete documentation, see: https://motoban.in/llms-full.txt
